78482.commentary: (VINa) puttacittaṃ upaṭṭhapessatī'ti putto me ayan'ti evaṃ gehassitapemavasena cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessati. esa nayo dutiyapade'pi.

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, upajjhāyaṃ. upajjhāyo, bhikkhave, saddhivihārikamhi puttacittaṃ upaṭṭhapessati, saddhivihāriko upajjhāyamhi pitucittaṃ upaṭṭhapessati.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, upajjhāyaṃ. upajjhāyo, bhikkhave, saddhivihārikamhi puttacittaṃ upaṭṭhapessati, saddhivihāriko upajjhāyamhi pitucittaṃ upaṭṭhapessati.
sace upajjhāyo gāmaṃ pavisitu'kāmo hoti, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saguṇaṃ katvā saṅghāṭiyo dātabbā, dhovitvā patto sodako dātabbo.

78485.meaning1: should be stopped; should be restrained
78485.commentary: (VINa) nivāretabbo'ti kiṃ bhante īdisaṃ nāma vattuṃ vaṭṭati, āpatti na hotī'ti evaṃ pucchantena viya vāretabbo. vāressāmī'ti pana katvā mahallaka, mā evaṃ bhaṇā'ti na vattabbo.

examples.text: na upajjhāyassa bhaṇamānassa antar'antarā kathā opātetabbā. upajjhāyo āpattisāmantā bhaṇamāno nivāretabbo.

78486.meaning1: should be deposited near; should be placed down close

examples.text: nivattantena paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññapetabbaṃ, pād'odakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.

78487.meaning1: should be sunned; should be warmed (in)
78487.meaningLit: to cause to be burned down

examples.text: sace cīvaraṃ sinnaṃ hoti, muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbaṃ, na ca uṇhe cīvaraṃ nidahitabbaṃ, cīvaraṃ saṅgharitabbaṃ, cīvaraṃ saṅgharantena caturaṅgulaṃ kaṇṇaṃ ussāretvā cīvaraṃ saṅgharitabbaṃ, mā majjhe bhaṅgo ahosī'ti.

78488.meaning1: should be placed; should be set down; should be laid aside

examples.text: sace cīvaraṃ sinnaṃ hoti, muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbaṃ, na ca uṇhe cīvaraṃ nidahitabbaṃ, cīvaraṃ saṅgharitabbaṃ, cīvaraṃ saṅgharantena caturaṅgulaṃ kaṇṇaṃ ussāretvā cīvaraṃ saṅgharitabbaṃ

78492.commentary: (VINa) na ca āsanā vuṭṭhātabban'ti na āsanā vuṭṭhāya sannipātamaṇḍale vicaritabbaṃ, vinayadhare uṭṭhite sabbā parisā uṭṭhahati.

examples.text: na pakatattena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekacchanne āvāse vatthabbaṃ, na ekacchanne anāvāse vatthabbaṃ, na ekacchanne āvāse vā anāvāse vā vatthabbaṃ, pakatattaṃ bhikkhuṃ disvā āsanā vuṭṭhātabbaṃ, na pakatatto bhikkhu āsādetabbo anto vā bahi vā.
tāsaṃ kho pana, bhante, bhaginīnaṃ evarūpo gandho hoti, seyyathā'pi nāma gandhakaraṇḍakassa tāva'd'eva vivariyamānassa, yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ gandhena vibhūsitānaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena isidattapurāṇā thapatayo sādhuke paṭivasanti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

āramanti ettha pāṇino visesena vā pabbajitā'ti ārāmo, tassa pupphaphal'ādisobhāya n'ātidūra-n'accāsannat'ādi-pañcavidha-sen'āsan'aṅga-sampattiyā ca tato tato āgamma ramanti abhiramanti anukkaṇṭhitā hutvā nivasantī'ti attho.

idh'ekacco antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho, na pavisa, bhante'ti vuccamāno pavisati, na tiṭṭha, bhante'ti vuccamāno tiṭṭhati, na nisīda, bhante'ti vuccamāno nisīdati, anokāsam'pi pavisati, anokāse'pi tiṭṭhati, anokāse'pi nisīdati

78497.commentary: (JAa) yaṃ bhūtaṃ sesaṃ amataṃ jīvamānaṃ, taṃ jīvamānam'eva dayitabbaṃ piyāyitabbaṃ mettāyitabbaṃ

examples.text: tatth'attani vatappaddhe, vinābhāve asaṃsaye, bhūtaṃ sesaṃ dayitabbaṃ, vītaṃ ananusociyan'ti.

78499.meaning1: should not be sorrowed; should not be mourned; should not be grieved
78499.commentary: (JAa) yaṃ pan'etaṃ vītaṃ vigataṃ mataṃ, taṃ ananusociyaṃ na anusocitabban'ti.

examples.text: tatth'attani vatappaddhe, vinābhāve asaṃsaye, bhūtaṃ sesaṃ dayitabbaṃ, vītaṃ ananusociyan'ti.
